For those not in the know...what exactly does "Gone Gold" mean?

I believe it means that the game is ready to print to physical disc and they can start production any time. "Gone gold" has lost some of its significance in recent years because development of a game will often continue after discs begin printing and the updated content is applied as a day one download. Look at how buggy and unfinished Halo: Master Chief Collection was; the day one download for that game was 15GB. Hopefully they're using the term to mean the game is all set and finished and that no further development is needed.
